★Request
*Inquiry
Would it be possible to give Sweep her "with hat" head model?

I state it emphatically, making sure my conviction comes through as strongly as possible.
Because to me, without a shadow of a doubt—

'Cause that's the most amazing magic of all!
After all, I'm Sweepy, the girl who's gonna be a great witch someday!

I desperately try to convey that that's truly how it looked to me. Praying that the little
apprentice witch standing before me won't lose sight of her magic.

Together with her grandmother, who lived the carefree life of a "great witch"—
she was a "magical girl" learning magic.

No matter how much I run, I can't find any magic!
And all the trainers and teachers just boss me around, just like all those lessons I used to take!!
Then my mind's made up! I'm gonna run in races too!!

Yes, the "Herb Geranium Magic" was a success.
This strong scent will drive away those pesky bugs, and what's more—

There, there. Come on, why don't you take a sniff?
It has a sweet, lovely scent that makes your heart flutter, doesn't it?
Okay, Grandma! Here goes...!!

And above all else—because hearing her story made me feel
as though I understood what her grandmother was thinking.

Plus, it makes for exceptionally delicious herbal tea and jam!
Now then, Sweepy, give me a hand with picking them.

I hate this, it's no fun at all! It's boring!!
Everything, every single thing has gotten so boring!!
Gera-Gera-Uninium~☆

Ahahaha! Is that so, is that so.
...I'm looking forward to seeing what kind of magic you'll use.

My sweet Sweepy.
If you are able to wield it—

Now then, are you ready, Sweepy?
Just do it—the way I taught you.

............*sigh*.
Maybe I should just... quit racing altogether.
Oho, the most amazing one, you say? ...Well now—

Even bigger...?
...Do you think I might be able to find magic there?

You don't get it? Dummy. A familiar is supposed to follow around
their master, the magical girl, and do ALL the chores for her!

What mattered most was that she herself had the desire to do it.
That was why her grandmother showed her magic—to give her that spark of desire.

Grandma, out of all the magic you've ever seen,
which one was the "most amazing"?
...That might just be the "racing magic."
Huh—

*sniff, sniff*... Ah, you're right!!
Amazing, amazing, it worked...!!

I came all the way to Tracen Academy to search for "racing magic"
because I wanted to learn how to use even more magic like that, but...
Nnnngh, of course you can't, dummy!!
...Nnnngh!!

I find myself shooting back without a second's hesitation.
...Because that run I witnessed during the mock race is still burned into my mind.
And I'm DEFINITELY gonna find the most amazing magic in racing, just like Grandma did, no matter what!!

(This is incredible! Magic is so, so much fun!!
I wanna do more... I wanna learn so, sooo much more!)

However, there is an extraordinary kind of magic that can only be used in that one place.
A long, long time ago, back when I ran in races, that's where I found it.

Okaaay!
Hehehe, Gera-Gera♪ U~nini~um...♪
Hey, familiar!! If you understand, stop spacing out and answer me!!

Her grandmother's house stood in a secluded place, surrounded by colorful flora.
Sweep Tosho spent every one of her days off there.

Ngh... But I made up my mind.
I promised I'd find "racing magic" just like Grandma...!

You have to stick by me until I find "racing magic"!
Got it?
—Things have suddenly taken an outrageous turn!

Wishing that she, who holds the wondrous potential to run as far as her heart desires,
can overcome this small stumble and move toward the path she chooses.

The racing world is special, you see. There are all sorts of magic there.
It makes your heart race, makes you thrill with excitement... and sometimes, it brings sorrow.
...Okay, starting today, you're my "familiar."
Haaaaah!!

And so, having decided for herself, and having
the desire to do so, Sweep Tosho entered the world of racing.

No matter how good she was at them, none of her various lessons were fun in the slightest.
But that was surely because she had never truly wanted to do them.

Hey, hey, Grandma!
I wanna learn even more magic, but—
You might just find a "thrill" more exhilarating than anything else—one that will change your life.

...Magic is supposed to be fun.
It blows all those boring feelings far, far away.

She is the only one who can fill her life with joy and make it shine.
Yet if she has hit a wall that is difficult to climb alone right now—
